maddeler.e:
نتواعد (form VI)
# نَتَوَاعَدُ (natawāʕadu) /na.ta.waː.ʕa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاعَدَ (tawāʕada)
# نَتَوَاعَدَ (natawāʕada) /na.ta.waː.ʕa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاعَدَ (tawāʕada)
# نَتَوَاعَدْ (natawāʕad) /na.ta.waː.ʕad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاعَدَ (tawāʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
